reviews.title: Got this app years ago (and  remember using it a lot)
reviews.contents:
Update: Got the developer to respond, and didn’t see the option as it is rather hidden I feel like (and unlike before where the music could be played in the app itself, it now just uses outside apps instead to help with sounds) but that’s fine to me because before music would just stop working when trying to play it in the app anyways. So rated 5 stars now for developer help and good answer!

Decided to check this app out again after several years (I bought the lifetime subscription back before there was a lot of other subscription options) and remember being able to use this app with music I had in my iPhone, with the app itself. (So if you had relaxing music, you could have that playing while also having the sounds the app had as well) However I noticed, now it doesn’t use that as an option anymore :( Just wanted to write this review, in case the developer will check this review out with an answer to if there is a reason for this or not (I’d understand if Apple came back at them saying they aren’t allowed to use music from people’s music library, but otherwise I feel like it would be something they should add back in, if possible) It’s cool that they supply other music options, but would really like to use some music that I’d provide, just for myself personally. (I’d rate it higher, as definitely feels worth it, but taking that away as an option just feels like a downgrade too, unless again Apple forced that hand)

reviews.title: Super soothing
reviews.contents: So when I tried this app it was a dream come true since I have anxiety I have a lot of hard time focusing in school and other activities so I try to find an app and this is the one I really love this because it gives you some session breathing exercises and a lot of meditation stuff which I really like and it helps me fall asleep faster since I have a hard time anyways I think this is the best meditation app for anybody in the world even if somebody doesn’t have anxiety depression or anything else I think it would be great for them to have this app because well it’s soothing and it helps you fall asleep plus if you’re doing some kind of art project or something you can use this to soothe your mind and just pop into creativity now so that’s why I really like this app very soothing calming and I just love the way that peoples voices are so nice and soft and you can change the voice volume and you can also change it to a male or female which is really good I use the female because well it’s more soothing to me but you can choose whatever you want I really like this app even my mom uses it and sometimes my dad uses it to do his work for his college but anyways I really like this app you can do a lot of sounds and a lot of meditation stuff It’s like you’re at a meditation spa but you’re really in your room and your own environment and now that this whole Covid thing is here for meditation retreats or spas so I think this is great if you need to get out more just relax after you had a long day of taking care of your kids or doing work

reviews.title: Love At First Site
reviews.contents: This app caused me wonderful yet strange dreams. I’ve never, ever had them until my brain got creative and took me to journies never seen before! I’ve been having these dreams since when I downloaded this app! It’s so peaceful & helps me sleep better. 2013, so it’s 2020, 7+ years of AWESOME! I love Sweet Hour Prayer, Cat Purring, Music Box, and much more! They are so calming and pleasing to hear. You might like other ones, and that’s cool, too! HIGHLY recommend this beauty sleeper. I sleep better and have been doing so for 7+ years after downloading. I deactivated my old account & deleted the app because I wanted to live without it since I slept better, but times I needed the app again. I redownloaded as a result & suddenly I have the free sounds. I saw the sweet hour prayer locked and felt bad even the other ones I’ve had immense dreams with. After hearing the ones I heard now (because I heard them too), it took me back to the dreams I had when I fell asleep with the sounds. I know, sounds weird, but I have memories even with sound and then I remember the DREAMS I had so good. I remember from the middle (a little of the beginning) and mostly the ending of my dreams, so I can picture them thanks to the sounds. TLDR; Some dreams were a little eerie or perhaps crazy, but that are dreams. And I love sleeping so thank you very very much! I enjoy this app! 5 STARS ⭐️ ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ P.S. I’m sorry for making a very long explaination.

reviews.title: Love This App, But One Critique
reviews.contents: I’ve been using this app for a while now and I listen to the sleep hypnoses almost every night to go to sleep. I could go on and on about why I love this app so much and I promote it to my friends and family any chance I get, but there is one thing I wish would be different that I hope the developers update and that is the Soothe Migraine Pain Hypnosis. I get migraines/really bad headaches every so often and I would absolutely love to use the meditation this app offers for them. However, the narrator is not right for me. Absolutely no hate to Michelle whatsoever, but to me personally, her voice is not soothing when it comes to migraine pain. Anyone who gets migraines knows that certain lighting, feelings, smells, and sounds are absolutely grating when you have a migraine. This is how I personally feel about the current narrator for the migraine hypnosis. I really love that with certain meditations you can change the narrator. My one suggestion/critique is that the migraine hypnosis should have this feature as well! I’m sure her voice helps many others ease their pain, but it does not ease mine. Again, no hate to Michelle, I really appreciate the work that she does. Her voice just does not groove with me and I think especially when it comes to pain, personalization and customization is really important. Other than this, I have no issues at all with this app and I absolutely love having it, which is why I have a paid subscription and have given it a 5-star rating! Keep it up, BetterSleep, and thank you for existing!!

reviews.title: Updated Review: Still the Best App & Antidote for My Insomnia
reviews.contents:
I want to give a shout out to the Better Sleep tech, creative and support teams are exceptional. This app continues to be the best antidote I have to battle my chronic insomnia. I been a subscriber of the app since the beginning of its release when it was Relax Melodies which has since evolved into a robust app BetterSleep. There is always something new to look forward to - new meditations, stories, sounds, music plus the thoughtful, scientific approach to bring elusive sleep to me. 
I use all elements of the app. I find the bedtime stories narrated by gifted storytellers with soothing voices particularly effective, allowing me to unwind, relax and drift off to sleep. The guided meditations have been invaluable, supporting me during anxious periods like elections :( . I get excited when there is a new story or meditation to keep my interest and experience with BetterSleep fresh, interesting and effective. I also wish to recognize and express my thanks for impressive customer service from the customer support and developer team who have worked with me to resolve a couple of technical issues over the years. I can honestly say that BetterSleep has been a game changer for me, supporting a good night sleep reducing the need of medication. To the entire team with a special shout out to the customer support team and mindfulness meditation leaders, narrators who are all gifted and amazing, I offer my deepest gratitude for the gifts of relaxation, health and, of course, Better Sleep. ❤️

reviews.title: Three things :)
reviews.contents: This app does exactly as it says it does! It has many features that help motivate me and help me feel rested. I’d suggest listening to one of the meditation sessions or a comfort story while taking a bath after a workout. Such a relaxing feeling. Overall a great app. The only disadvantage is you miss out on a lot of the many stories and meditation sessions if you don’t buy the subscription. Due to the inflation (and my lack of money) I do not have enough to buy the subscription and thus miss out on a lot of interesting stories that I want to listen. It gets repetitive after awhile. My suggestion that might help with that issue would be having a single story or meditation for each category/series so that both a paying and non-paying user can get a variety of all the features while still keeping the value of the subscription. This might even garner more purchases; somebody eventually gets interested in a particular genre or series and wants to listen to more of it. My second suggestion would also be to add singular purchasable content. This can insure that people interested solely in — let’s say — mixes or brainwaves can be able to buy it, without having to worry about monthly payments or buying more than what they want. These two options could be a win-win solution for both the user and the company (more downloads and purchases - more customer satisfaction). This probably won’t happen but I wanted to voice my opinion. I’m still probably gonna use the app regardless but I hope these ideas are still considered whenever they are seen. Thank you!

reviews.title: Hands down best sleep/soundscape app
reviews.contents:
I’ve tried a lot of things for sleep sounds. But, year after year after year (how long have I been using this? A decade at least!), I consistently use this app. It’s always improving, even though I’ve never personally found it lacking. It’s amazing to have so much ability to customise mixes. I like layering multiple water sounds, brown noise, and a little quiet thunder. It’s created an almost Pavlovian response; I start playing my mix, and next thing I know, I’m asleep. 

I’ve struggled with sleep my entire life, partially due to just luck with biology, and also severe PTSD. I used to wake dozens of times in a night. Every small sound or shift in the room or house, and I’d be awake, full of anxiety. And certain sounds/frequencies bother me and/or trigger migraines, and that made it hard to play sounds that would both sufficiently drown out the tiny noises and also not leave me in pain. I’m a difficult customer. 🤷‍♀️

But this app is, and I cannot emphasise it enough, the absolute crown champ in its genre. Now in fairness, I’ve done a lot of work to reduce my sleep issues and PTSD symptoms, but it’s really nice to have an app that I can make work for me, for any kind of day, regardless of symptoms. It’s not a cure, obviously, but it never pretends to be. It’s just a sleep sound app that goes all in on what it aims to do… and it succeeds.

reviews.title: An Exceptional App for Stress Relief and Sleep Improvement
reviews.contents: I’ve had this app on my phone for quite some time, and since I have a fair amount of experience with international travel, I usually manage jet lag pretty well. However, with my recent move to a new country, it’s not just the jet lag that’s been keeping me awake—it’s also the stress of adapting to a different environment and culture that has thrown off my sleep cycle. I finally remembered downloading this app and thought it was the perfect time to give it a try. First off, as a designer, I have to applaud how easy the app is to use. The navigation is seamless, the interface is incredibly user-friendly, and the overall experience is calming. I love that I can filter the sounds to suit my preferences, and the variety of options for customizing my sleep music is impressive (I’m excited to dive deeper into these features). Plus, being able to track my sleep cycle while the app runs in the background as I read an e-book on my phone is a huge bonus. The free trial definitely got me hooked and reinforced the idea that this is a top-notch product. I’m excited to explore even more of the app’s features in the coming days, but I can already say that it’s helped me manage my stress and put my body into a more relaxed state—thanks to the brainwave features, which are well-described with their specific frequencies. Whoever came up with this concept made sure it’s both unique and highly personalized, giving the app a distinct personality that stands out from the rest. Kudos to the creative minds behind this, to the Developers, and UX/UI designer as well. :)

reviews.title: This app saved my life
reviews.contents: After my mother's bloody death, sleep became a distant memory. I was up all the time. Couldn't sleep. I still felt her blood on me, heard her panicked voice.....I never thought I'd sleep again. Then.....I discovered better sleep. It did what other apps don't. It turned my phone into my friend. Helped me relax through all kinds of meditations, bedtime stories and more. I began to find joy in turning on my phone, putting on a story and listening to the narrator as I fall asleep. It didn't take long for me to get hooked on this app. In a good way. Better sleep is like a friend. A life long dear friend.....no....it's more like.....it's a compassionate experience like what you get when you're a child held by your mother. The voice overs are so gentle and inviting while the background music is so magical and mood inspiring. The stories are something you can't help but embrace. The meditations are guided by the narrator as if it's a teacher in your room. Better sleep is my hero. Wonder if this could have saved mom if I had known abiut better sleep back then. Thank you better sleep for giving me a future to look forward to. I was starting to think I would live the rest of my life fearful of sleep. Now I live my life normal again with a healthy view of sleeping, wrapped in the arms of my friend, better sleep.
